ai.help.title: Help & Tips
ai.help.welcome-desc: Your intelligent companion for data exploration and analysis.
ai.help.feature-conversations-desc: Ask questions in plain English. No need for complex queries.
ai.help.feature-search-desc: Search across your data, documents, and history.
ai.help.feature-suggestions-desc: Get follow-up questions to dive deeper into topics.
ai.help.feature-export-desc: Export conversations to Markdown for documentation.
ai.help.example-customers: How many customers do we have?
ai.help.tip-specific-desc: The more specific your question, the better the answer. "Show sales for Q4 2024" is better than "show sales".
ai.help.tip-context-desc: Reference previous answers. Say "break that down by region" to get more detail.
ai.help.tip-styles-desc: Use the style selector for different response formats - concise for quick answers, detailed for explanations.
ai.help.tip-pin-desc: Pin conversations you want to keep handy. They'll appear at the top of your list.
ai.help.tip-feedback-desc: Rate responses with thumbs up/down to help improve future answers.
ai.help.tip-edit-desc: Made a typo? Edit your message and the AI will regenerate its response.
ai.help.faq-data-desc: Your conversations are stored securely and only accessible to you. We don't share your data with third parties.
ai.help.faq-delete-title: Can I delete my chat history?
ai.help.faq-delete-desc: Yes! You can delete individual conversations or archive them for later reference.
ai.help.faq-wrong-title: What if the AI gives wrong information?
ai.help.faq-wrong-desc: Use the feedback buttons to report incorrect answers. You can also regenerate responses or rephrase your question.
ai.help.faq-limits-desc: Usage depends on your plan. Check your account settings for current limits.
ai.help.faq-export-desc: Yes! Use the export button to download conversations as Markdown files.

ai.error.encountered_issue: I encountered an issue while trying to answer your question: ":question".
ai.error.timeout_guidance: The query took too long to execute. Try asking a more specific question or limiting the scope.
ai.error.syntax_guidance: There was an issue with the generated query. Please try rephrasing your question.
ai.error.generic_guidance: Please try rephrasing your question or contact support if the issue persists.
ai.error.scoping_blocked: I couldn't run that query safely for your team's data, so I won't guess. Could you rephrase or narrow the question?
ai.error.busy_try_again: I'm answering a lot of questions right now, so I couldn't start on yours yet. Nothing is broken and your question is saved — send it again in about :seconds seconds.
ai.error.understanding_unavailable: I couldn't process your request because of a temporary problem on my side. Please try again in a moment.
ai.tasks.not-understood: I didn't quite understand. Could you rephrase?
ai.tasks.review: Here is the summary. Check it, then confirm or cancel.
ai.tasks.cancelled: All right, I stopped. Nothing was changed.
ai.tasks.expired: This has stopped because it went on too long. Nothing was changed. You can start again.
ai.tasks.limit-reached: I can't go further with this here: a limit was reached. Nothing was changed. You can do it from the usual form.
ai.tasks.daily-limit-reached: You have reached today's limit for doing this with the assistant. Nothing was changed. You can do it from the usual form, or try again tomorrow.
ai.tasks.stale: This summary has changed since it was shown. Review the new one.
ai.tasks.not-waiting: This is no longer waiting for your confirmation.
ai.tasks.not-allowed: You can no longer do this. Nothing was changed.
ai.tasks.failed: It could not be completed. Nothing was saved.
ai.tasks.acknowledge-first: First tick each item marked on the summary.
ai.tasks.busy: Another confirmation is in progress. Try again in a moment.
ai.tasks.nothing-to-change: Nothing would change: every value is the one already saved.
ai.tasks.offer: I can also do it for you here: “:task”. Just reply to get started.
ai.tasks.still-reviewing: The summary above is still waiting for you: confirm it or cancel.
ai.tasks.changed-since: Something on this summary changed since it was shown, so nothing was saved.
ai.tasks.not-changeable: This item can't be changed here. Confirm or cancel the summary.
ai.tasks.unavailable: I can't answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
ai.tasks.expired-on-return: Your “:task” had stopped; nothing was changed.
ai.tasks.other-in-progress: “:task” is in progress. Continue it, or stop it and start the new one?
ai.chat.error-connection: I'm having trouble connecting to the database. Please try again.
ai.chat.error-timeout: The request took too long. Try a simpler question.
ai.chat.error-generic: I encountered an error processing your question. Please try rephrasing or try again later.
ai.error.data_part_failed: Note: I couldn't retrieve the data part of your question right now, so I can't say anything about your data. Please try again in a moment.
ai.error.data_part_blocked: Note: I couldn't run the data part of your question safely for your team's data, so I won't guess about it. Could you rephrase or narrow that part?
ai.error.data_part_denied: Note: your access does not let me read the data part of your question, so I won't say anything about it. Someone with more access in your organization can see it.
ai.error.no_access: Your access does not let me read this information, so I can't answer this question. Someone with more access in your organization can see it.
